"import cadquery as cq

# Hard-coded task parameters (mm) -- no randomness
L = 90.0        # plate length along X
W = 70.0        # plate width along Y
T = 6.0         # plate thickness along Z (base at z=0)
FILLET_R = 9.0  # radius on all four vertical (Z-parallel) edges
HOLE_D = 7.0    # through-hole diameter
HX = 29.0       # hole center X offsets (+/-)
HY = 19.0       # hole center Y offsets (+/-)

# Reliable sequence: plate -> fillet vertical edges FIRST -> through holes LAST
part = (cq.Workplane("XY")
        .rect(L, W)                      # centered on origin in XY
        .extrude(T)                      # base face at z=0, thickness along +Z
        .edges("|Z")                     # select the 4 vertical edges
        .fillet(FILLET_R)                # fillet before drilling
        .faces(">Z")                     # start hole sketch on top face
        .workplane()
        .pushPoints([(-HX, -HY),
                     (HX, -HY),
                     (-HX, HY),
                     (HX, HY)])
        .circle(HOLE_D / 2.0)
        .cutThruAll())                   # holes through full thickness only

solid = part.val()
cq.exporters.export(solid, "part.step")"
